results.answer:
Chest pain, a racing or irregular heartbeat, or fainting can be signs of a heart problem — including, in Lyme disease, inflammation affecting the heart's electrical system (Lyme carditis).

This needs care right now. Call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

A severe headache together with a stiff neck, sensitivity to light, or confusion can be a sign of inflammation around the brain or spinal cord.

This needs care right now. Call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

New drooping on one side of the face or trouble closing one eye can be a sign of nerve involvement — which can occur in Lyme disease (facial/Bell's palsy) but also has other causes that need prompt evaluation.

Please be seen today: go to urgent care or an emergency room, or call your doctor's office now and describe these symptoms.
